title: Create request

client.name: Company name
client.noInnNote: The company has no tax ID: the request will create a client with this name.

contact.name: Name
contact.channelsHint: At least one channel is required: Telegram, phone or email

summary.label: Request summary
summary.hint: What the client needs: items, volume, timing

letter.label: Letter or request file
letter.hint: PDF, image or Office document up to 25 MB
letter.tooLarge: The file is larger than 25 MB
letter.unsupported: PDF, image or Office document only
letter.noteFailed: Could not build the call note: {{reason}}. Attach a file.
letter.noteFailed_request: Could not build the request note: {{reason}}. Attach a file.
letter.noteNeedsCaller: First enter who called on the Contact step
letter.noteNeedsConsent: The call note is built once consent is marked on the Contact step
letter.noteNeedsConsent_request: The request note is built once consent is marked on the Contact step
letter.noteNeedsSummary: First fill in the request summary

noteReasons.generic: the document could not be built
noteReasons.letterhead_missing: no company letterhead is set up

consent.missing: The client has not given consent yet.
consent.viaBot: A Telegram lead gives consent in the bot: ask them to press “I agree”.

consequence.lead: The lead becomes a client and you become responsible for the conversation; the bot keeps answering for this client.
consequence.request: A request with a number appears in records.
consequence.letter: The letter goes to the director in “Documents · Incoming letters”{{urgent}}.

clientGets: The client gets: “Request № … accepted, we are calculating” and an “Open portal” button — in Telegram or by email.

done.title: Request created
done.text: The request is going to records; the request number will appear on the client card.
done.repeated: This request has already been created — showing it.

errors.contact: Pick a contact or enter a name
errors.channel: At least one channel is required: Telegram, phone or email
errors.consent: A request cannot be created without the client's consent
errors.handoff_no_consent: The client has not given data consent — record how it was received
errors.consent_via_bot: A Telegram lead gives consent in the bot — ask them to agree
errors.contact_channel_required: The contact has no Telegram, phone or email
errors.invalid_phone: Phone must be in international format, e.g. +998 90 123 45 67
errors.request_not_allowed: The lead is lost — a request cannot be created from it
errors.request_key_reused: The form is outdated — open “Create request” again
errors.erp_not_configured: Records are not connected — contact the administrator
errors.telegram_linked_elsewhere: The lead's Telegram is already linked to another client
errors.letter_required: Attach the client's letter or request file
errors.letter_call_consent: Mark consent on the Contact step to get the basis note, or attach a file
errors.letter_failed: The file did not upload — pick it again or another one
errors.request_not_failed: The request is already being sent or was sent to records — refresh the card
errors.request_not_retryable: Retrying will not help: the request data changed after sending — create the request again
errors.enqueue_failed: Could not queue the sending — try again a bit later
errors.generic: Could not create the request. The form data is kept — try again
errors.letter_uploading: Wait for the file to upload
errors.do_not_work: We do not work with this company: a request cannot be created

draft.found: There is a request draft from {{time}}

partner.title: Partner
partner.intro: The application goes to “Partner applications”. The lead does not become a client.
partner.channelsHint: Email is required: the contract is sent there

done.title: Lead handed over as partner
done.text: The application is created, the lead is closed.
done.repeated: The lead was already handed over — this is the same application.

errors.erp_unavailable: Accounting does not respond — your data is kept, try again shortly
errors.generic: Could not hand over. Your data is kept — try again
